payload.claim: `_creation_order` tests `f.kind in ("run_created", "run_finished")` as a literal tuple, restating the same two kind strings that `saffron/ledger.py` already names in `_RUN_FACT_KINDS` (used for the identical purpose in `fold_task`/`_run_for`). `fold.py` already imports other underscore-prefixed names from `saffron.ledger` (e.g. `UnplacedRebuttal`, and `_REVISION_PATH`/`_ledger_time` elsewhere in the repo), so importing `_RUN_FACT_KINDS` instead of restating its members would keep one source of truth for which kinds mark a run-fact task.
